eidolons.name: Ere My Death, I Stood Unmade
eidolons.desc: While the Zone is active, decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by 20%. After using the extra Skill from Talent, the "Infinite Fury" countdown has its action delayed by 15%.

eidolons.name: Ash Was My Heart, Yet the Flame Stayed
eidolons.desc: When an ally character uses Ultimate to deal DMG, it is considered as having launched Follow-Up ATK. And the Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by ally targets increases by 75%. The upper limit of Mortenax Blade's Charge decreases to 7.

eidolons.name: Across the Shore, Wrath Laid Bare
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Odium I've Smitten, Thence Came the Blade
eidolons.desc: "Heart, Refined ad Infinitum" additionally increases ally targets' DMG dealt by 50%.

eidolons.name: I Severed My Woes, Knowing Death Begets Life
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: If Immortality Could Die, I Swore THEM Slain
eidolons.desc: As the Zone persists, when Mortenax Blade takes DMG or consumes HP, he gains 1 Charge. This effect can trigger again after any target's turn ends. The DMG multiplier of "Tenax Per Ignem" increases to 150% of its original value.

basic.name: A Broken Blade Still Slays
basic.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy, and causes the target to enter the Taunt state for 1 turn.

skill.name: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate
skill.desc:
Consumes HP equal to 10.0% of Mortenax Blade's Max HP and deals Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to all enemies, and additionally deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to {1}% of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one random enemy.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses Skill.
While not in the "Infinite Fury" state or when the current HP is 1 or lower, Mortenax Blade cannot use his Skill.
Using Skill does not consume Skill Points.

ult.name: Fornax Ex Corpore
ult.desc:
Inflicts "Balefire Bind" on all enemies. Enemy targets in the "Balefire Bind" state have their DEF reduced by {2}% and the DMG they receive increases by {1}%, lasting for 2 turn(s). Then, consumes HP equal to 20% of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to deploy a Zone. While the Zone is active, Mortenax Blade enters the "Infinite Fury" state.
During the "Infinite Fury" state, increases CRIT Rate by 20%, increases CRIT DMG by {0}%, enhances Basic ATK, unlocks Skill, and gains a new Ultimate "Tenax Per Ignem." When receiving a killing blow, this unit will not be knocked down, but will dispel the Zone, exit the "Infinite Fury" state, and restore HP equal to 50% of this unit's Max HP.
When gaining the "Infinite Fury" state, a corresponding countdown appears on the Action Order. The countdown has a fixed SPD of 70. At the start of the countdown's turn, dispels the Zone and exits the "Infinite Fury" state.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses this ability.

talent.name: All Karma Comes Due
talent.desc: While the Zone is active, after each attack an ally target uses on an enemy, inflicts the "Balefire Bind" state on the corresponding enemy target and grants 1 Charge to Mortenax Blade. When Charge reaches 9 points and the current HP is more than 1, consumes 9 Charge, regenerates {0} Energy, and enables Mortenax Blade to use Skill 1 extra time. This extra Skill use is considered as Follow-Up ATK.

extra.name: A Tempered Blade Severs Souls
extra.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy, and causes the target to enter the Taunt state for 1 turn.

extra.name: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate
Tenax Per Ignem
extra.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to {0}% of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to all enemies.

technique.name: Blade's Reach Spares None
technique.desc: Immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, inflicts the Taunt state on all enemies for 1 turn and decreases DMG taken by this unit by 90% for 2 turn(s).

ability_1.name: Bone, Hardened ad Nauseam
ability_1.desc: Mortenax Blade can accumulate up to 80 overflow Energy. After using Ultimate, clears it and regenerates a corresponding amount of Energy. When the battle starts or when the Zone is dispelled, if Energy is below 75%, it is immediately regenerated to 75%. When Energy is regenerated to its maximum, dispels all debuffs from this unit.

ability_2.name: Soul, Tempered ad Mortem
ability_2.desc: While the Zone is active, increases the chance of being attacked by enemies, decreases DMG taken by this unit by 50%, and increases Incoming Healing by 50%. After being attacked, inflicts the "Balefire Bind" state on the corresponding target, and enables Mortenax Blade to gain 1 Charge.

ability_3.name: Heart, Refined ad Infinitum
ability_3.desc: While the Zone is active, ally targets deal 50% increased DMG. If there are other Nihility characters aside from Mortenax Blade in the team, Ultimate DMG dealt by ally targets increases by 75%. Otherwise, DMG dealt by Mortenax Blade additionally increases by 75%.

lightCones.name: Reforged in Hellfire
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 30%/37%/45%/52%/60%. At the start of the wearer's turn, regenerates a fixed amount of 20 Energy. This effect can trigger 1 time each wave. After the wearer uses Skill to attack, inflicts the target with the "Purgatory" state, lasting for 2 turn(s). While in the "Purgatory" state, the target receives 30%/37%/45%/52%/60% increased CRIT DMG and 30%/37%/45%/52%/60% additionally increased CRIT DMG from the wearer.

lightCones.name: Lies Dance on the Breeze
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by 18%/21%/24%/27%/30%. After the wearer uses an attack, there is a 120% base chance to inflict the "Bamboozle" state on every enemy target. While under the "Bamboozle" state, enemy targets have their DEF decreased by 16%/18%/20%/22%/24% for 2 turn(s). If the wearer's SPD is higher than or equal to 170, there is a 120% base chance to inflict the "Theft" state on every enemy target. While under the "Theft" state, enemy targets have their DEF decreased by 8%/9%/10%/11%/12% for 2 turn(s). When "Bamboozle" or "Theft" is repeatedly inflicted, only the most recently inflicted instance takes effect.

lightCones.name: Before the Tutorial Mission Starts
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. When the wearer attacks DEF-reduced enemies, regenerates 4/5/6/7/8 Energy.

lightCones.name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat
lightCones.description: When the wearer hits an enemy and if the hit enemy is not already "Ensnared," then there is a 60%/70%/80%/90%/100% base chance to "Ensnare" the hit enemy. "Ensnared" enemies' DEF decreases by 12%/13%/14%/15%/16% for 1 turn(s).

lightCones.name: Holiday Thermae Escapade
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's DMG dealt by 16%/20%/24%/28%/32%. After the wearer attacks, there is a 100% base chance to inflict the attacked target with Vulnerability, increasing the DMG they receive by 10%/11%/13%/14%/16% for 2 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.

lightCones.name: Good Night and Sleep Well
lightCones.description: For every debuff the target enemy has, the DMG dealt by the wearer increases by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%, stacking up to 3 time(s). This effect also applies to DoT.

relicSets.name: Divine-Querying Master Smith
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases Max HP by 12%. 4-pc: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG dealt to enemy targets in the DEF reduction state by 28%. After the wearer inflicts the DEF reduction state on an enemy target, all allies gain "Comburent" for 2 turn(s). This effect cannot be stacked. The DMG dealt by ally targets with "Comburent" increases by 15%. This effect can be triggered again after the wearer uses an attack.

relicSets.name: Eagle of Twilight Line
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases Wind DMG by 10%. 4-pc: After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their action is Advanced Forward by 25%.

planarSets.name: Sprightly Vonwacq
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 120 or higher, the wearer's action is Advanced Forward by 40% immediately upon entering battle.

planarSets.name: Bone Collection's Serene Demesne
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 12%. When the wearer's Max HP is 5000 or higher, increases the wearer's and their memosprite's CRIT DMG by 28%.

planarSets.name: Lushaka, the Sunken Seas
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. If the wearer is not the first character in the team lineup, then increases the ATK of the first character in the team lineup by 12%.

teams.name: Mortenax Blade with Acheron
teams.description: Mortenax Blade's debuffs count for Acheron's Ultimate and Welt adds even more, while Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae shields the team. Archer, Ashveil or The Herta can take Acheron's place, and Sparkle or Robin can replace Welt.

teams.name: Mortenax Blade Nihility Team
teams.description: An all-out damage version with no sustain: only for content where you can kill quickly. Jiaoqiu, Tribbie, Cipher, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae or Hyacine fit the last slot for a safer team.

teams.name: Mortenax Blade Follow-Up Team
teams.description: Ashveil's follow-up attacks with Tribbie's extra damage. Feixiao, Aventurine • Waveflair, Robin, Topaz & Numby, Moze or Cipher can replace Tribbie, and Aventurine or Hyacine can replace Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae.

teams.name: Mortenax Blade Beginner Team
teams.description: Easy-to-get characters only: March 7th (Imaginary) attacks, Asta speeds the team up and Lynx heals.

lore.description:
His body is like springwood. His heart is like dead ash. Yet still, a craftsman's spark cling to his fingertips.
Ancient grudges flare anew. He vows to send both himself and that God over to the other shore.
This body torn asunder, yet holding fast through a thousand temperings into a blade... What answer will it forge?
stories: He still remembered those early days in the Zhuming, gazing up at the endless shelves of forging manuals, the armory's display of divine weapons stretching out like an endless sea. As a mayfly never sees the night, a cicada knows nothing of spring and autumn. For the first time in his life, he truly understood how small a man could be next to the ages. With the short lifespan of his kind, he'd be lucky to even scratch the surface of the forging art. He could only start from scraps, filling the crumbling smelting furnace with coal slag. He failed. That sword seemed flawless and sharp beyond measure, yet shattered into pieces when he flicked his finger to test it. "A useless blade..."Burning with shame, he hid it away. What he didn't see was his white-haired master running a finger across that broken sword, nor the thin red line of blood it left on his fingertip. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft. Good." He remembered the shackles he forged for the Ten-Lords Commission. "Forging a blade is like tempering the soul. The real skill is making the simplest thing well." He didn't understand. If his skills were already exceptional, why did his master make him start from being an apprentice? But he never argued. He believed in the general's words, just as he believed that a true gem never stays buried for long. His fellow disciples came, the Flamewheel Octet came, Huaiyan came. They all watched him, laboring day and night without rest in the Forge. Until the flames finally died out, and they laid eyes on the most fearsome shackles of their lives. The cold gleam of those manacles was muted, but their menace weighed on one like a mountain. No one could have imagined that years later, the imprisoned Borisin Warhead would spend long, long years locked up in chains cut from the same cloth. He remembered the trial for Furnace Master. But for a short-life species to be chosen as the chief craftsman of the Zhuming, that was unprecedented. He'd prepared himself well. But when the smelting began, he found that all his materials had been swapped for rotten scrap. He just smiled. A day and a night later, he unveiled a delicate, ingenious mechanical lion, a creation that put any treasure-forged contraption to shame. He remembered how before being granted the title "Furnace Master," his master repeated that simplest of questions— "What makes a blade?" He'd never once hesitated in his answer. That was the peerless weapon he was meant to forge, the one that would leave every other blade in the dust. Yet when these distant memories resurface, all he could hear was the mournful howls of shattered blades.

He joined the Stellaron Hunters to seek the ultimate "salvation"... At least, that's what the Hunters promised. Clink, clank, bullet casings clattered to the ground, like some kind of melody. "Oh no, I'm all out of bullets." The lady raised both hands, eyes darting toward the sky. The night was silent. Then a pillar of light pierced the heavens, hurtling toward the hunters. The madman charged straight into it. The high-energy beam nearly tore him apart. No, clearly not. His flesh was like rampant spring ivy, knitting itself back together in the blink of an eye. "Stop testing my loyalty! If I find out your promises were nothing but lies, I'll be the first to put a blade through you!" "Listen to me, Bladie. As long as you don't want it, no one can make you bleed." The Antimatter Legion before her eyes was torn to shreds by a dark figure. A silver mech punched what few Voidrangers remained into dust, then turned to watch, helpless, as one man danced alone against an army. "Remember, Sam, whatever you do, don't get caught in his sword formation." She recalled Kafka's parting words before the mission. And now, staring at the gruesome wreckage before her, she understood what it meant to be a blade— He was the sharpest "Blade" of the Stellaron Hunters. Clink, clang, the snow came down all night, so thick it nearly buried the camp whole. The silver-haired girl stepped out of her tent and found him still sitting cross-legged, sword laid across his knees. "Get some rest. I'll take watch tonight." "No need. I'm used to it." "Hmph. Weirdo." She watched as snow piled up on his shoulders, as if it had turned his hair white. A deep chill suddenly washed over her. She understood then. There were some people in this world who could only find a moment's peace on these barren, empty snowfields.

Chaos. Darkness. The belly of the beast from the dawn of the universe seemed ready to dissolve everything. He'd thought himself numb to pain long ago, but now an invisible struggle threatened to tear his soul to shreds. Petty whispers chattered on and on inside his head, step by step, coaxing him toward the abyss of ruin. "Why resist? I can grant you the power to reforge life and death itself, to undo all your regrets!" Undo all regrets... He thought of Master Huaiyan, the disappointment in his eyes. He thought of the five of them, once so full of promise. He thought of the ending he should have had... No. Not that. Never that. Not once, not ever. This was nothing but escape, cowardice, surrender... Just like those years spent rotting in regret. Just like this aimless, half-dead existence, wandering from day to day with nothing but the wish to die. That wasn't how his "script" was supposed to "end." "Stellaron Hunters exist to rewrite Finality, and to rewrite their own endings." In the "Finality" Elio revealed, he glimpsed a sea of spider lilies scattered with bones, a boundless beast skewered through, and a furnace belching flames. Black hair turned white as snow, and the aged artisan could finally embrace death. Yet the root of the immortality calamity had already bloomed anew elsewhere... He still has a chance to change it all. "Yingxing, are you really so bent on dragging us both into the abyss!? All you'll gain is endless suffering, torn between life and death!" He didn't hear Shuhu's frenzied roar. Instead, he heard his master's voice, his companions' voices, his own voice— "What makes a blade?" He had once forged shackles to cage the mighty foes. Now, he would forge himself into a prison. As a hunter, his sole pursuit had been the elusive release of death. Now, he would take revenge on the architect of this tragedy. He felt himself cracking apart. Piece by piece. Shard by shard. Like snowflakes torn asunder, frozen in an instant by a surge of boundless life, then sent drifting once more into the sea of suffering. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft. Good." With great effort, he raised his hand, just as he had many years ago when he first lifted the forging hammer, striking the white-hot metal until it was sharp enough to plunge that immortal abomination to unending hell. His scorching iron body couldn't shed tears. In his daze, he could almost believe he was still in the Forge, blazing with blinding radiance like a divine weapon fresh from quenching.

He thought of that lonely island of Insumousu, bristling with rusted, broken swords. He wanted to go back, just once, to let those sword cries of grief, of hatred, of sorrow, rest in peace, if only for a moment. He thought of his aging master, and the warmth born of longing and shame welled up in his chest. Closing his eyes, he could almost smell the smoke and fire of the Zhuming, hear the endless rhythm of hammers on anvils. "Once this is all over, maybe I could..." He let out a long sigh. Then he turned and walked back to the Hunters' camp. "Mara-struck? He's completely cured... At least he's no longer clamoring to skin that little azure dragon alive." "Oh, right, about that box Blade mentioned, he admitted that the stuff inside was a gift for us!" He gently pushed the door open, frowning: "Do I really need to report matters unrelated to the mission to her as well?" "Bladie, thank you." A woman's voice came through the phone. "No need." "We'll celebrate for you once everyone is back." The man paused, took a few steps, then stopped again. "The item in the iron box is poorly made. If you want, I can make another." "Okay, sure," the young girl looked at him in surprise, "then why don't you tell her yourself? Look, talking to you just made me have to restart again!" He didn't reply, but turned around and headed to the next room. "Practice hard, the next time we PK when your hand is healed, I won't go easy on you." "Okay." He unfastened the Shard Sword and placed it by the bed. In the past, it was resentment, it was fury, it was regret, it was the embodiment of all agony. He stroked the shattered blade. What exactly constitutes a blade? Perhaps a blade is simply a blade, nothing more.
